nom: Vacation Super Stick SPF 45 Face Stick Sunscreen

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally say it doesn't feel oily, greasy or heavy and works well under makeup, though one says the satin, slightly glowy finish is less matte than she would prefer for long workdays.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin say it leaves their skin hydrated and protected without stripping, but one reviewer found the stick itself too dry and difficult to glide on — requiring heavy pressure — and calls it not suited to dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who also describe their skin as sensitive or dry-leaning, report it works well for them without irritation or excess shine.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no redness, stinging, eye irritation or breakouts, even when other sunscreens bother them; two reviewers using the same formula noted brief redness and irritation right after application that stopped after a few uses, and one reviewer cautions the scent may be too strong for sensitive skin on the face specifically.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin, and others generally, report the stick leaves skin feeling hydrated rather than stripped, with the coconut and aloe content specifically credited; one reviewer with dry skin, however, found the stick itself hard and dry to glide on, needing heavy pressure, and would not repurchase for that reason.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers who say other sunscreens cause them stinging or redness report this one feels calm and comfortable, with no redness, in some cases despite normally reactive skin; two reviewers using the same formula did note about five minutes of mild redness and irritation right after application (traced to the niacinamide), which they say stopped occurring after a few uses.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers across skin types, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone, consistently report no new breakouts and no clogged pores; no reviewer in this set reports the opposite.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report it doesn't feel oily, heavy or greasy, though one reviewer with oily skin says the satin, slightly glowy finish is less matte than she'd prefer for long workdays, calling it not ideal but not a deal-breaker.

aspects.libelle: Hard to glide on without pressure
Cap or lid hard to remove
Compact size lasts longer than expected

extraits.texte: I don't hbderstand all the good reviews. Maybe I got a bad batch. It did not glide on easily, you have to apply pressure so if you're wearing makeup it will get messd up. It also leaves my face feeling sticky to the point that my hair sticks to my face. It feels like I put a gluestick or Chapstick on my face.

I love the shape of the sunscreen stick. It's pointed on one end so it's easy to get under the eye area and on the nose. However, I find this formula very dry and difficult to apply. I have to press very hard in order to get the product on my face simply because it is not emollient enough. Luckily the formula doesn't disturb my makeup underneath. It works but I will probably not purchase this again.

- Pros: The biggest plus for me when using this face stick sunscreen is how easy it is to reapply. I can just swipe it on and go, which is perfect for busy days or when I'm out and don't want to deal with liquid sunscreen. It's small, lightweight, and easy to throw in my bag, so I always have it with me. I also love that it doesn't have that strong sunscreen smell. The texture is lightweight and doesn't feel waxy at all. Right after applying it in the morning, I can definitely see the satin finish. It gives my skin a smooth, slightly glowy look. I know a lot of people are into that, but since I have oily skin, I usually prefer something more matte, especially for long workdays. It's not a deal breaker though, and it still works really well under makeup or even on its own.- Cons: I did notice is that when I first started using it, my skin got a little irritated and red for about five minutes after applying. I checked the ingredients and saw "Niacinamide", so people that have sensitive skin should be aware. After a few uses, my skin got used to it. Overall, I'd give it a solid 4 out of 5."Product was received as part of an educational promotion." **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Amazing sunscreen for brown skin tone
extraits.texte: I wear sunscreen on my face every day. I have dry skin and this sunscreen worked amazingly and left my dkin feeling hydrated and protected. The size is perfect for everyday use and travel. It easily fits in a purse, pocket, or carry-on. I really like that it comes in a solid stick with a twist-up dispenser similar to deodorant, which makes application quick and mess-free.There is a slight fragrance to it which i love and doesn't bother me at all. The formula applies clear and glides on smoothly without needing to be to rub it into the skin . It isn't greasy, shiny, or sticky on the skin . I have sensitive skin and eyes, and I was happy that this sunscreen didn't cause any redness, eye burning, breakouts, or irritation. It feels lightly moisturizing, and I especially appreciate that it is dermatologist tested and contains coconut, aloe vera, and niacinamide. I love the packaging on this sunscreen. It applies so easily and effortlessly on the skin . Overall, I'm very impressed with this sunscreen and plan to continue using it daily. extraits.titre: Fine for sensitive skin and safe for everyday use!
extraits.texte: I live in Florida and wear sunscreen on my face every day. With combination, sensitive skin, I've tried many different sunscreens, and after using this one for a week, I'm genuinely impressed.The size is perfect for everyday use and travel—it easily fits in a purse, pocket, or carry-on. I really like that it comes in a solid stick with a twist-up dispenser similar to deodorant, which makes application quick and mess-free.The light fragrance is another plus. It's subtle and beachy, and it honestly makes me smile because it feels like being on vacation. The formula applies clear and glides on smoothly without needing to be rubbed in. It doesn't tug at the skin and isn't greasy, shiny, or slippery.I have sensitive skin and eyes, and I was happy that this sunscreen didn't cause any redness, eye burning, breakouts, or irritation. It feels lightly moisturizing, and I especially appreciate that it is dermatologist tested and contains coconut, aloe vera, and niacinamide.One feature I found unique is the raindrop shape of the stick. The narrow tip makes it much easier to apply around the nose, eyes, mouth, and ears, helping ensure better coverage in those areas.Overall, I'm very impressed with this sunscreen and plan to continue using it daily. It really stands out compared to many others I've tried, and I would definitely recommend giving it a try. Note: I received this product as part of an educational promotion. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

If you need a reliable sunscreen stick, this one is a great choice. It has a pleasant texture and compact packaging, so it fits easily in my bag. It applies quickly and smoothly, feels very light on my skin, and does not leave my face oily. It goes on completely clear with no white cast or streaks. There is a slight sheen, but much less than many other sunscreens. It also does not run into my eyes or sting, and I do not notice any unpleasant taste when applying it around my mouth.It works well under makeup or over makeup, blending easily without disrupting my base. If you wear very heavy makeup, it may not be ideal for frequent touch-ups, but it works well for my routine. It has no greasy finish or strong smell, and it makes reapplication throughout the day easy. Since I started using it, wearing sunscreen daily has been much easier.I have acne-prone and sensitive skin, and this is the first sunscreen I have tried that has not caused breakouts. It feels lightly moisturizing, and as someone who burns easily, I have not gotten sunburned while wearing it. It is one of the best sunscreens I have used. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Easy to carry for daily use!
extraits.texte: I really liked using the Super Stick SPF 45 Sunscreen by Vacation. It comes in a teardrop shape that makes it so easy to get around the nose and corners. It smells amazing! It also absorbs pretty fast and doesn't leave any sticky or oily residue. Even with my oily skin, this gave me a satin finish and didn't feel oily nor heavy on my skin. I used this alone and under makeup and didn't disrupt my makeup. If putting this on top of makeup, it will move some of the foundation around but this is why I preferred to use it under makeup. I also did have issues gliding it at first but once I put a little bit of pressure or a moisturizer, it glided so much better. The stick also works well when needing to push more product out or even pushing the product back in. It's perfect to carry with you so you can easily reapply! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.
